quest.title: Treasures Under the Sea: Epilogue
quest.description: Ulman is planning the future of his business enterprise...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Ancient Iron Coins... Ancient Iron Coins... Nice, very nice!

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: #With so many Ancient Iron Coins, I'm sure I can make a pretty pile of Mora! Thanks a ton, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you plan on doing next?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Of course, I'm going to... think of a way to exchange these Ancient Iron Coins for Mora, or other convenient and useful items.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: But seriously, I really don't want to get tangled up with that middleman from before. He takes a huge cut every time.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Not only that, but it takes forever for him to get my money to me. I haven't got a clue what he's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: But... Other than him, I simply can't find anyone reliable to work with... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Enough of that! These are for you, consider it a bonus for our fruitful long-term cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Once my business here in Fontaine is over, I'll need to think carefully about my next steps. I can't just keep traveling, that's way too tiring...
